info.name: Lynq App Backend
info.description: Core business API of the lynq-app-backend service: users, companies, resumes, job posts, applications and LLM-backed suggestions under `/dmz`, plus service-to-service endpoints under `/internal`. Every request requires the `lynq-request-uuid` header (403 if missing). `/dmz` requests also require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, validated against lynq-iam (401 if missing or invalid); log in with the "Auth (lynq-iam)" folder first. `/internal` requests require `lynq-internal-token` instead. Requests that create resources auto-save their ids into collection variables.

exec: // Generate a fresh request UUID per call so log tracing stays unique.

item.name: Auth (lynq-iam)
item.description: Obtains an access token from lynq-iam so this collection works standalone. lynq-app-backend validates every `/dmz` bearer token against lynq-iam.

request.description: Authenticates against lynq-iam with username + password and saves the returned access token into `accessToken`. Log in as an R_CANDIDATE user for candidate endpoints and as an R_COMPANY user for company endpoints.

item.name: User
item.description: Endpoints under `/dmz/user`: the caller's profile, profile image, resumes, applications and upskilling suggestions. Requires a bearer token; resume and application endpoints require R_CANDIDATE.

body.raw:
{
  "fullName": "John Doe",
  "currentPosition": "Backend Developer",
  "about": "Java developer focused on Spring Boot microservices.",
  "githubUrl": "https://github.com/johndoe",
  "linkedinUrl": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/johndoe",
  "birthDate": "1995-04-12"
}

request.description: Creates the Lynq profile for the authenticated IAM user. Any authenticated role. Returns 201; saves `userId`.
Returns the authenticated user's profile, including `companyId` when the caller is R_COMPANY. Saves `userId` and `companyId` when present.

body.raw:
{
  "fullName": "John Doe",
  "currentPosition": "Senior Backend Developer",
  "about": "Java developer focused on Spring Boot microservices and AWS.",
  "githubUrl": "https://github.com/johndoe",
  "linkedinUrl": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/johndoe",
  "birthDate": "1995-04-12",
  "expectedSalary": 3500,
  "expectedSalaryCurrency": "USD"
}

request.description: Partially updates the authenticated user's profile; only the fields sent are changed. Returns 200, 400 on invalid salary or currency (ARS|USD).
Returns the public profile of any user by id. Any authenticated role. Returns 404 if the user does not exist.

query.description: Name of the image file to upload.

request.description: Registers a profile image upload in lynq-file-storage and returns a pre-signed upload URL plus its `fileId` (saved into `fileId`). Upload the file to the URL, then confirm it.

query.description: File id returned by the generate upload URL call.

request.description: Confirms the uploaded profile image and makes it the user's current one. Returns 204, 400 if the file is not the pending profile image.

query.description: Name of the resume file to upload.

request.description: Registers a resume PDF upload and returns a pre-signed upload URL plus its `fileId` (saved into `resumeFileId`). Requires R_CANDIDATE (403 otherwise).

query.description: File id returned by the generate resume upload URL call.

request.description: Confirms that the resume PDF was uploaded to the pre-signed URL. Requires R_CANDIDATE. Returns 204.
Lists the languages a resume can be stored in (code + name). Requires R_CANDIDATE.
Stores a structured resume linked to an uploaded PDF (`fileId`). Requires R_CANDIDATE. Returns 201 and saves `resumeId`; 400 if the file is already used by another resume.
Lists the caller's resumes with their JSON content and a PDF download link. Requires R_CANDIDATE. Saves the first `resumeId` if none is set.
Renames one of the caller's resumes (alias up to 100 characters). Requires R_CANDIDATE. Returns 404 if the resume does not belong to the caller.
Pages through the job applications of the caller. Requires R_CANDIDATE.

query.description: Output language for the suggestion (default en).

request.description: Asks lynq-llm for upskilling suggestions for the caller against a job post. Requires R_CANDIDATE. Returns 404 if the job post does not exist.
Deletes one of the caller's resumes. Requires R_CANDIDATE. Returns 200 with the deleted resume id, 404 if not found.

item.name: Company
item.description: Endpoints under `/dmz/company`: company onboarding, logo upload, detail and update. Requires a bearer token; creation requires R_COMPANY.

body.raw:
{
  "fullName": "Jane Doe",
  "currentPosition": "Head of Talent",
  "userAbout": "Hiring engineers for Example Corp.",
  "linkedinUrl": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/janedoe",
  "birthDate": "1990-08-23",
  "companyName": "Example Corp",
  "companyAbout": "Example Corp builds software for example purposes.",
  "companySize": 50
}

request.description: Creates the caller's user profile together with the company they own. Requires R_COMPANY. Returns 201 and saves `companyId` and `userId`; 400 if the company name already exists.
Returns a company's public detail by id. Any authenticated role. Returns 404 if the company does not exist.
Partially updates the company owned by the caller; only the fields sent are changed. Returns 200, 404 if the caller owns no company.

query.description: Name of the logo file to upload.

request.description: Registers a logo upload for the caller's company and returns a pre-signed upload URL plus its `fileId` (saved into `fileId`).

query.description: File id returned by the generate upload URL call.

request.description: Confirms the uploaded logo and makes it the company's current one. Returns 204, 400 if the file is not the pending company logo.

item.name: Job
item.description: Endpoints under `/dmz/job`: job post management for companies and search, detail and applications for candidates. Requires a bearer token.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Backend Developer",
  "description": "Build and maintain Spring Boot microservices.",
  "workType": "REMOTE",
  "salaryRangeDown": 2000,
  "salaryRangeTop": 3500,
  "salaryCurrency": "USD",
  "jobPostSource": "LYNQ",
  "skills": [
    "Java",
    "Spring Boot",
    "MySQL"
  ],
  "similarityTags": [
    "java",
    "spring-boot",
    "backend"
  ]
}

request.description: Creates a job post for the caller's company. Requires R_COMPANY. Returns 201 and saves `jobId`; 400 if the caller is not linked to a company.
Pages through the job posts created by the caller. Requires R_COMPANY.

request.description: Replaces the editable fields of a job post, including its status (OPEN|CLOSE). Only the job owner; returns 403 otherwise, 404 if the job does not exist.
Pages through available job posts, optionally filtered by free text. Any authenticated role; candidates also get a `lynqScore` per job. Saves the first `jobId` if none is set.

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('jobId') && data && data.content && data.content.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('jobId', data.content[0].jobId);

request.description: Returns the full detail of a job post as seen by a candidate. Any authenticated role. Returns 404 if the job does not exist.
Increments the job post's view counter and returns the new total. Any authenticated role. Returns 404 if the job does not exist.

Applies the caller to a job with one of their resumes (`resumeId`) or with an uploaded file (`fileId` + `resumeName`). Requires R_CANDIDATE. Returns 201, 400 if neither is sent, 409 if already applied.
Pages through the candidates who applied to a job, with their Lynq score. Only the job owner; returns 403 otherwise. Saves the first candidate's user id into `candidateId`.
Asks lynq-llm to explain how a candidate (user id) fits a job. Only the job owner; returns 403 otherwise, 404 if that candidate did not apply.

query.description: Output language for the suggestion (default en).

request.description: Asks lynq-llm for upskilling suggestions for the caller against this job. Requires R_CANDIDATE. Returns 404 if the job does not exist.
Closes an open job post. Only the job owner; returns 403 otherwise, 400 if the job is not open.
Reopens a closed job post with a new creation date. Only the job owner; returns 403 otherwise, 400 if the job is not closed.

item.name: Internal Events
item.description: Endpoints under `/internal/events`. Service-to-service only: authenticated with `lynq-internal-token` instead of a bearer token.

request.description: Republishes the stored domain events to the SNS domain-events topic and returns published/failed counts per event type. Internal endpoint: no bearer token, requires the `lynq-internal-token` header (401 otherwise).

item.name: Internal Job Ingest
item.description: Endpoints under `/internal/job-posts` for scraped job ingestion. Service-to-service only: authenticated with `lynq-internal-token`.

body.raw:
{
  "jobPosts": [
    {
      "externalId": "ext-0001",
      "title": "Java Developer",
      "description": "Spring Boot developer for an example company.",
      "workType": "REMOTE",
      "salaryRangeDown": 1500,
      "salaryRangeTop": 2500,

      "jobPostSource": "LINKEDIN",
      "companyName": "Example Corp",
      "companyLogoUrl": "https://cdn.example.com/logo.png",
      "postedAt": 1767225600000,
      "skills": [
        "Java",
        "Spring Boot"
      ],
      "similarityTags": [
        "java",
        "backend"
      ]

request.description: Upserts a batch of external job posts keyed by `externalId` and `jobPostSource`, returning counts of jobs, companies, skills and tags written plus skipped and reopened posts. Returns 400 on an empty or invalid batch. Internal endpoint: no bearer token, requires the `lynq-internal-token` header (401 otherwise).

item.name: Internal Job Verification
item.description: Endpoints under `/internal/job-posts` for checking whether ingested job posts are still live. Service-to-service only: authenticated with `lynq-internal-token`.

request.description: Returns the ingested job posts due for a liveness check, bounded per category. Internal endpoint: no bearer token, requires the `lynq-internal-token` header (401 otherwise).

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('jobId') && data && data.candidates && data.candidates.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('jobId', data.candidates[0].id);

request.description: Records the liveness outcome (ALIVE|CLOSED|GONE|UNKNOWN) of up to 500 job posts. Returns 400 on an empty or oversized batch. Internal endpoint: no bearer token, requires the `lynq-internal-token` header (401 otherwise).

Closes ingested job posts that have not been verified within the expiry window and returns how many were expired. Internal endpoint: no bearer token, requires the `lynq-internal-token` header (401 otherwise).

item.name: Internal Score
item.description: Endpoints under `/internal/score`. Service-to-service only: authenticated with `lynq-internal-token`.

request.description: Computes Lynq scores for job/candidate pairs from the given skill and tag profiles (up to 5000 each). Returns 400 on an empty or oversized batch. Internal endpoint: no bearer token, requires the `lynq-internal-token` header (401 otherwise).
